title: 20th Century / Modern 2
description: Revise concepts associated with 20th Century / Modern up to Advanced Higher. These features and forms may also occur in other periods.

items.prompt: Name the compositional approach using a predetermined ordered series, especially a row of twelve chromatic pitch classes and its transformations.
The simultaneous use of more than one key or tonal centre.
Name the ordered source collection of all twelve chromatic pitch classes used in twelve-tone composition, rather than the compositional method itself.
As a melodic or tone-row transformation, upward intervals become downward by the same size, and downward intervals become upward. Name the transformation.
A melody or tone row is presented in reverse order, beginning with its final note and ending with its first.
Give the German term literally meaning speech-song for a vocal delivery between speaking and singing.
The time signature changes during the music, altering the number or grouping of beats and sometimes unsettling the pulse.
Two independent parts divide the same span evenly into three notes and two notes respectively. Name the cross-rhythm ratio, rather than a single-line tuplet.
Give the Italian term for a short repeating musical pattern, also called a riff.
Name the general musical device of restating a phrase or section unchanged.
Rhythmic emphasis is placed on weak beats, off-beats or notes held across strong beats.
